profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ Gemini | Systems Programming, DevOps
profile.summary:
Began my career in the Defense & Aerospace industry writing host software for tactical data link radios, software for embedded applications, and Electrical prototyping for PCB design.

I now focus primarily on C++ development, and any form of tinkering on the side.

2015 graduate from The University of Dayton with a Bachelors of Science in Computer Engineering as well as a minor in Computer Science.

positions.title: C++ Software Engineer
positions.description: With a background in defense software, I'm applying my knowledge of C++ and Linux Systems Programming to design performant and stable trading systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Trading Systems · C++ · Systems Programming · DevOps · Linux

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development of back and front end software solutions to various military applications in Windows, Linux, and Android operating systems. Technologies mostly include the C/C++, C# and Java programming languages.

Other Roles include:
- Code Revision Control
- Embedded Systems Development
- Electrical Prototyping
- Software Documentation
- 3D Design and Printing

positions.title: Research Fellow
positions.description: My primary duties included CCD (Charge Coupled) camera based telescope image collection, documentation of telescope assembly and calibration, dome-telescope synchronization software development, as well as many other astronomy oriented research duties. Most dome-telescope interfacing software was written in Python.

educations.degreeName: Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering
